desc:
NEW GAUNTLET-ENDLESS MODE!

Fight off the horde with your squad in this co-op zombie shooter!

Pick from 20+ operators, each with their own gadget and ability. Gear up from 60+ guns, from the MP5 all the way to mutant-tech legendaries. Then drop in together:

- Daily Missions - Normal, Hard, Nightmare difficulties
- Weekly Rotating Raid: up to 20 players fighting against hordes of zombies
- Gauntlet: survive endless waves of increasingly strong zombies 

Grab upgrade cards mid-mission to build your run, including Legendary Fire, Lightning and Frost upgrades. Open loot crates, level up, unlock skills, and hit the gym to grow your strength and rebirth.

Daily rewards, challenges and badges to earn. Play on PC or mobile.
